title: Photoluminescent exit path markings.
officialText: The installation of photoluminescent egress path markings shall be subject to special inspection. The special inspector shall verify that approved photoluminescent egress path markings were provided and installed in accordance with department rules and regulations, the approved construction documents, and manufacturer’s instructions.
